gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve details about a specific assigned add-on for an incoming phone number so that I can understand its configuration and usage.
gold.ideal: The response should include the add-on's SID, friendly name, and any configuration parameters associated with it.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I need to remove an assigned add-on from an incoming phone number to ensure that it is no longer in use.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the successful deletion of the add-on and return a status message indicating the operation was completed.

gold.user: As a product manager, I want to see all assigned add-ons for a specific incoming phone number to evaluate their effectiveness and usage.
gold.ideal: The response should provide a list of assigned add-ons, including their SIDs and friendly names, along with any relevant metadata.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to assign a new add-on to an incoming phone number to enhance its functionality with additional features.
gold.ideal: The response should include the SID of the newly created assigned add-on and its configuration details.
